name: Testament
overview: The biblical concept of 'Testament' primarily refers to a will, a solemn declaration that takes effect upon the death of the testator, as Hebrews 9:16-17 explains. This idea is fulfilled in the New Testament through the blood of Christ, which establishes a new covenant between God and believers. Passages such as Matthew 26:28, Mark 14:24, Luke 22:20, and 1 Corinthians 11:25 emphasize that Jesus' sacrificial blood inaugurates this new testament, securing the remission of sins and inviting believers to remember His redemptive work.
